tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi dngos grub srung zlog gi man ngag dgra bgegs nges par 'joms par byed pa gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mtshon cha zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rgya gar skad du/ shrī aṣṭa badzra ma hā kṛṣṇa sya siddhi rakṣa ṇi barya syopa de sha sha rāti bhū ta ni ba dha naka ya sha ni dzwa la shast+ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi dngos grub srung zlog gi man ngag dgra bgegs nges par 'joms par byed pa gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mtshon cha zhes bya ba/ dpal khrag 'thung he ru ka dang rdo rje nag po chen po mched brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di nyid kyi sgo nas srung zlog bsad gsum dang*/ mnan sreg 'phang gsum gyi mjug sdud dang bcas pa'i las kyi rim pa las/ srung ba dang*/ bsad pa dang*/ drag po zlog pa'i rim pa ni zur du gsal zhing*/ mjug gi las mnan pa dang*/ sbyin sreg rnams kyang yig cha logs su gsal yod pa ltar las/ 'dir gtor ma'i zlog pa dang zor gyi las bstan pa ni/ dang po 'di nyid kyi dbang lung mnos shing bsnyen pa tshad du 'khyol ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ gnas dben par bskang gzhung gi gtor ma dang*/ gzhan yang bskang gtor/ rtags gtor sogs kyi yo byad thams cad 'du byas la/ zlog pa'i gtor ma bca' ba ni/ mdos khri'i khar ri rab bang rim bzhi pa phyogs mdog can gyi 'og tu/ rang la gang gnod pa'i dgra bgegs kyi liṅga ming rus dug khrag gis sbags pa bting ba'i steng du/ gtso bo'i gtor ma zur gsum dbal can dug khrag gis sbags pa rgyan dang ldan pa'i nang du/ oṃhrīḥhahahuṃhūm̐phaṭa/ oṃbadzrakawuwawapashayabadzramahākālātsaturhastadagrabagegasaganodabyedathams cadabhyoḥzlog /mahākālāguṇahṛdayabyadakhaphurakhathanadangaltasangana'agalarkyenabarachadamimathunapa'iphyogasathamasacadadagradangabagegasalabhyozlogazorayaphyephye/ zhes bris pa dang shā sa na gzhug /mdun du thugs yum gyi gtor ma'i nang du/ oṃshrīyadewīkālīkālīmahākālīhūm̐bhyoḥ dgra bgegs nas phye phye'i bar sham bu gong ltar dang*/ shā sa na bcug |g.yas su phyag drug gi gtor ma'i nang du/ oṃbadzramahākālākṣiṃkṣetrapālabighnānabināyakahūm̐phaṭaḥ

dgra bgegs sogs sham bu gong ltar dang/ shā sa na bcug /rgyab tu gur gyi gtor ma'i nang du/ oṃbadzramahākālāyahuṃhūm̐phaṭaḥdagra bgegs sogs gong ltar dang*/ shā sa na bcug /g.yon du zhal bzhi'i gtor ma'i nang du/ oṃmahākālākālābikāl rātritadzadzahūm̐phaṭaḥ dgra bgegs sogs gong ltar dang*/ shā sa na bcug /gtor chen gyi mdun shar dang*/ g.yas lhor byas pa'i dbang gis shar lhor beng gi gtor ma'i nang du/ oṃmahākālādubeṃnidzadagraborutrahūm̐bhyohūm̐/ dgra bgegs sogs dang*/ shā sa na bcug /lho nub tu ma ning gtor mar/ oṃshrīmahākālāgaṇaguhyaraṃsiddhihūm̐phaṭaḥ dgra bgegs sogs dang*/ shā sa na bcug /nub byang du stag zhon gyi gtor mar/ oṃmahākālātriyaṃdzaḥ dgra bgegs sogs dang*/ shā sa na bcug /byang shar du rnam sras kyi gtor mar/ oṃbaishramaṇāyaḥ dgra bgegs sogs dang*/ shā sa na bcug /gtor ma brgyad po 'di yang gtso bo'i bong tshad kyi sum gnyis su slebs pa zur gsum dug khrag gis sbags pa rgyan dang ldan pa sha stag go| |dbus kyi gtso bo'i steng du bya khyung gi mgrin par/ garuḍatsaletsalehūm̐phaṭaḥ dgrabagegasaganodabyedathamasacadargyugasaphyeyashazohorardungachomamirangazorgyugasargyugs// zhes dar dang dgra bgegs sham bu btags la bcug |khyung gi phyag g.yas par ral gri dang*/ g.yon sbrul za ba/ gshog pa g.yas pa me ri la tho ba 'bar ba dang*/ g.yon pa rlung ris lcags kyus mtshan pa bris shing*/ mjug sgro gnam lcags kyi ral gri 'bar ba la/ dbu stod khro zhal dbu smad rdo rje'i bya mchu can so dang mche ba gtsigs pa/ sku lus khra bo la rkang pa bya'i sder mo can du bya/ de'i steng du gdugs nag po dang mda' rgod sgro ma dar mthing ga dang me long la dug khrag gis hūm̐ bris pa btags pa rnams bcug /phyogs mtshams kyi gtor ma brgyad la dar mthing nag gi gdugs re re btsugs/ gtor ma rnams kyi logs dang*/

zur du rtsang dmar po gnyis bsnol te brgyan rtsang du sha rgyun sogs mthong rgyud ltar bang rim dang por/ zur bzhir rgyal mtshan phyogs mdog btsugs/ bang rim gnyis pa la/ shar du 'phar ba dang spyang ki/ lhor seṅge dang stag /nub tu dom dang rta/ byang du lug dang bya rnams bcu gsum mam/ bdun nam/ lnga re rab 'bur du dod pa dang*/ 'bring yang byang khrar gzugs/ bang rim gsum pa la/ rdo rje nas rlung gi bar gyi phyag mtshan rnams byang khra'am 'bur du dod pa/ bang rim bzhi pa la/ shing thuur khrag gis sbags pa'i rtse mor bya nag /lug nag /g.yag nag dang*/ mi nag po 'o dod 'bod cing brang rdung ba dang*/ bud med nag mo skra 'bal zhing mtshan ma mdzub mos 'bru zhing ston pa/ dgra bgegs kyi liṅga mgo thur du bstan pa dang*/ gzhan yang stag dang*/ spyang ki/ seṅge/ dom sogs gcan gzan mang po dang*/ gnam la 'phur dgu/ sa la 'dzul dgu thams cad kyi gzugs zan nag las byas pa rnams bskyon la btsugs/ shing thur de dag gi rtsa bar mtheb skyu/ changs bu/ sha dum mang du bkram/ mdos khri'i steng du dug khrag dang ro sol gyis sbags pa'i rtsang dmar brgya rtsa brgyad bsnol thabs su btsugs pa'i rtse mor sha dum gyis brgyan cing*/ zur bzhir mda' dar phyogs mdog dang*/ ru dar nag po la ba dan nag pos brgyan pa zur re rer med ka med du 'dzugs/ logs bzhir 'dzugs pa ni mi 'thad pas so// de'i phyi skor du mdos dkris dkar pos g.yogs la 'bru nag gi dkyil 'khor dbus ling tshe dgu pa'i steng du khri'i mañdzi'i khar bzhugs su gsol ba'i mthar/ dug khrag gi yon chab/ bong bu dang mi'i chu la gla rtsis sbags pa'i zhabs bsil/ dug sna tshogs kyi me tog /mi'i sha tshil klad pa rkang rnams la gu gul dang sa las sbags pa'i bdug spos/ mi rta khyi gsum zhun gyi mar me/ dug khrag la gla rtsi dang ga puur gyis sbags pa'i dri chab/

'bru nag gi ngar phye la dug dang sha chen sogs sna tshogs kyis sbags pa'i lha bshos dmar po zur gsum dang*/ rnga dang*/ cha lang*/ thod rnga/ mi rkang gi gling bu/ dril bu sogs kyi rol mo rnams g.yas su bskor thabs su bshams shing*/ lag gis bsgyur ba dang de dag gi mthar/ shar du liṅga brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang du/ oṃmahākālādagrabagegasaganodabyed aṃkushadzadzaḥ mārayarbadasodaḥ ces bris te bcug pa dang*/ lhor changs bu brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang du/ oṃmahākālādagrabagegasaganodabyedabidweshayaphaṭadagrabagegs gnodabyedast+waṃyananalaṃrbad/ ces dang*/ nub tu ong skyu brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang du/ oṃmahākālādagrabagegasaganodabyedamohayaphaṭaḥ ces dang*/ byang du gtor chung brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang du/ oṃmahākālāganodabyedadagrabagegasa.utstshatayaphaṭaḥ ces bris te bcug pa rnams phyogs so sor bsham/ gzhan yang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i g.yab dar nag po rol mo sogs nyer bsdogs byas la mdos kyi zhal shar ram byang du gzigs zhing*/ sgrub pa po rnams kha nub bam lhor phyogs pas bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod gtor tshogs bskang ba bsnyen pa kha gso ba'i rim pa rnams legs par bgyis nas/ sgrub po rnams la las bskang ba dang*/ la las shā sa na 'don/ la las gzhi snying 'dogs bcas 'don par bya zhing*/ mdos kyi mdun sla nga sogs lcags snod du zor gdan gyi liṅga ming rus bris pa dug khrag gis sbags par phur bus gzir ba dang*/ de dang nye bar mgon po'i thun zor las bshad pa ltar gyi bon nam/ mdze'am/ rabs chad dam/ lkug pa sogs kyi thod pa mtshan ngan du/ yungs kar nag /ke tshe/ shang tshe/ zi ra dkar nag /lcags phye/ zangs phye/ bra bo/ ram pa/ g.yer ma/ sbang ma/ mkhar rgong sogs la khrag sna dang dug snas sbags pa dmar com me ba/ gzhi snying dang shā sa na'i sngags kyis gzir ba byugs pa'i ltag khung dang 'gram rnams su rtsang gis brgyan pa dar nag gis bkab la bshams/

liṅga dang mchod pa sogs kyi phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhir mi nag bzhi dang*/ mtshams bzhir dbyi mong dang dug gi shing las byas pa'i rnga mong mi kha'i rdzas kyi phad bu bkal ba bzhi rnams bsham mo// gzhan yang rang gi mdun gyi nye logs su liṅga rab brgya rtsa brgyad bcu tshan/ 'bring lnga bcu tshan/ tha ma nyi shu gnyis tshan du bsdebs pas bcu dang*/ phur bu shan gri yungs kar sogs kyi thun rdor dril rnams bshams la/ stan bde bar 'khod de/ phrin las kyi cho ga brtsam pa'i dang po mdos la sman raka dang chu chang bran te/ la las shā sa na 'don/ la las bskang ba 'don/ rang nyid bdud chas su zhugs la/ lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas rig pa ngar dang bcas ba'i ngang nas ngag tu/ phaṭaḥ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid he ru ka gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi gtor ma la phog pas stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis ri rab bzhi pa phyogs kyi mdog can gyi steng*/ dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ chos kyi 'byung gnas dmar po'i lte bar sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma dgra bgegs kyi gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag las rdo rje'i gri khug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog char sprin ltar gnag cing zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing me 'od 'phro ba/ khro gnyer smin ma'i dbus su bsdus pa/ smin ma dang sma ra rnams bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing sbrul nag gis dkris pa'i khrod du rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas mtshan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug gis thod khrag dkrug pa'i tshul dang*/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang tri shūl 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa/

rno zhing 'khyog pa'i mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i khrod nas khrag gi rgyun 'dzag cing ljags 'gyur ba hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ shangs nas bskal pa'i rlung gi rgyun 'tshubs pa/ sku thung zhing gsus pa shin tu che ba'i snying po g.yas su 'khyil ba/ thod skam lnga rin po che'i rtse phran can skra mtshams su bcings pa/ thod rlon khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu rgyu ma'i thag pas sbrel ba'i do shal 'phyang zhing*/ mi rus kyi phyag rgya lnga dang klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sbrul nag gi chun po'i se ral khas spras shing sku stod la glang chen gyi ko rlon mgo g.yas su phyogs pa dang*/ skaid par mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi'i rkang lag sked par mdud nas grol ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs kyis zhabs kyi 'gag yan chad bklubs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon cung zad brkyang ba tsandan 'khyil ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyi gtsug gi thad kyi nam mkhar lcags kyi bya khyung nag po khro zhal can rdo rje'i bya mchu la mche ba bzhi gtsigs shing*/ ljags gyen du bskyod pa rdo rje pha lam gyi rwa nam mkha'i dbyings su bsgrengs shing dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra ag tshom dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi ral gri dang g.yon sbrul zhal du gsol ba/ dar dang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ gshog sgro g.yas pa me yi bu yug gi klong nas khro chu tho ba thogs pa dang*/ g.yon bskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshub pa las khro bo lcags kyu thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ mjug sgro ral gri 'khor los gtams pa'i tshul can du gyur pa/ de lta bu'i steng gi nam mkhar sprin nag 'khrugs pa'i klong nas 'brug gi sgra 'byin zhing rdo rje me'i ser ba dang*/ gnam lcags thog gi bu yug rab tu 'tshub pa bskal pa'i me rlung 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/ chos 'byung gi zur gsum du las kyi mgon po bka' sdod bya rog gi gdong pa can gsum sku mdog nag po spyan gsum rdo rje'i bya mchu can gri khug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/

'khor lo'i mu khyud la shar du sha za nag po seng ge'i gdong can dang*/ ma mo bya rgod kyi gdong can/ byang du khyung gi gdong can/ nub tu khwa ta'i gdong can/ lhor 'ug pa'i gdong can/ shar lhor phag gi gdong can/ lho nub tu khyi'i gdong can/ nub byang du spyang ki'i gdong can/ byang shar du stag gi gdong can/ de rnams kyang sku mdog nag po spyan gsum mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis dor stabs su bsgrad nas dgra bgegs gsod pa'i las byed par gyur/ mdun gyi rtsibs steng du ro'i gdan la thugs yum tsaṇḍi ka nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis mda' gzhu dang dgra mgo 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa zhabs phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa ma mo bye bas bskor bar gyur| g.yas kyi rtsibs steng du log 'dren bi nā ya ka'i gdan la myur mdzad mgon po zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ g.yas gsum gyis gri gug /thod khrag /ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon gsum gyis thod khrag */rtse gsum/ zhags pa 'dzin cing dpral bar sindhu ras mtshan pa rgyan dang bcas te zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs pa yum re ma ti dang 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ rgyab kyi rtsibs steng du ro'i gdan la gur gyi mgon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa'i gru mo gnyis kyi steng du rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇḍi bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs can yum tsa muṇḍi dang 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ g.yon gyi rtsibs kyi steng du ro'i gdan la mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon tsa turmu kha sku mdog nag po rtsa zhal nag po mi ro za zhing steng zhal dud kha/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag bzhi pa'i dang po gri thod tha ma gnyis ral gri dang mi rus kyi phreng ba 'dzin pa/

mchan khung g.yon du chang gi bum pa thogs pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa yum chen bzhi dang 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ shar lho'i rtsibs steng du ro'i gdan la tsandan gyi beng sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas beng rgyug dang g.yon lcags par bsnams pa/ rgyan dang bcas shing ber nag gsol ba zhabs gnyis dor stabs su bzhugs pa yum zlog byed ma dang 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ lho nub kyi rtsibs steng du ro'i gdan la dpal mgon ma ning nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon thod pa dgra snying gis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ ber dmar gsol zhing zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i dor stabs can| yum kro tī shwa rī dang 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ nub byang gi rtsibs steng du mgon po stag zhon sku mdog nag po zhal cig phyag gnyis kyis gri khug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol nas rgya stag khra bo la bcibs nas yum gtum mo dang 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ byang shar gyi rtsibs steng du drag byed mthing nag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang ba dan gyis brgyan pa'i dbyug pa 'phyar zhing g.yon byang chub chen po'i mchod rten thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa dbu skra dang sma ra me ltar 'bar ba srin po khros pa lta bu/ seng ge sngon po rab tu rngam pa'i steng na rol pas yum me tog gtsug phud ma dang rta bdag brgyad sogs 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ de'i phyi rol du nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ gnod sbyin khri/ gang po mdzes ma/ mkha' 'gro 'bum/ bka'i lha srin sde brgyad| lo zla zhag dus kyi bdag po gza' skar dregs byed dpag tu med pas yongs su bskor ba de ltar gsal ba'i gtso bo dgu'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ bdag dang gtso bo dgu'i thugs ka'i sa bon las/ 'od zer 'phros pas dur khrod chen po brgyad dang*/ chos 'khor gtsug lag khang chen po rnams nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad la sprul pa'i dmag tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba skad cig gis spyan drangs/ zhes mos la spos bsregs/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te zlog pa'i dpung spyan drangs pa ni/ dbyangs snyan pa'i nga ro dang g.yab dar mi rkang gi gling bu dang bcas te 'di skad do// hūm̐ */ bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po// bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can// bdag ni khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ /khyod ni nag po chen po ste// chos kyi srung ma thugs dam can// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// rnal 'byor dam ldan skyong ba'i phyir// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon// rnal 'byor bdag la dgra byung na// dam can khyod kyis ma tshor ram// bdag la byad kha byung ba dang*// dgra bgegs gdug pa 'tshe ba 'di// dam can khyod kyis ma tshor ram| |khyod kyis thugs dam nyer dgongs te// dur khrod gnas nas sku bzhengs la// do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon// thugs yum rtsa 'jib nag mo ni// ma mo'i klong nas sku bzhengs la// do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon// myur mdzad phyag drug mgon po ni// chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la// do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon// dpal ldan gur mgon chen po ni// rang bzhin gnas nas sku bzhengs la// do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon// drag byed tsa turmu kha ni// kha'u khrag nas sku bzhengs la// do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon| |yab gcig mgon po beng chen ni// dug mtsho'i klong nas sku bzhengs la// do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon// dpal mgon ma ning nag po ni// 'og min gnas nas sku bzhengs la| |do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon// mgon po stag zhon nag po ni// dur khrod gnas nas sku bzhengs la// do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon// drag byed ngal bsos chen po ni//

ri rab zom nas sku bzhengs la// do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon// bya rog gdong can las byed gsum// sha za nag po seng ge'i gdong*// drag byed las kyi mkha' 'gro brgyad// bya rgod khyung dang khwa ta dang*// 'ug pa'i gdong dang phag dang khyi// spyang ki stag gi gdong can brgyad// nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba mkha' 'gro 'bum| |gnod sbyin khri dang gang mdzes tshogs// lha srin sde brgyad drag byed 'khor// ma lus 'khor gyi dpung tshogs bcas// nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang dang*// sa 'og dur khrod la sogs pa// rang rang gnas nas sku bskyod cig /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon// dpal chen khrag 'thung spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// sngon gyi thugs dam nyer dgongs nas// do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon// rnal 'byor bdag la dgra byung tshe// dam can srung ma'i ra mda' yis// dgra bgegs sgrol bar mi mdzad na// chos skyong srung ma'i thugs rje chung*// dam tshig las 'das rdo rje yi// dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur zhes bshad// de bas 'jigs par mi 'gyur ram// da lta bdag gi gzhal yas 'dir// mgon po nag po 'khor dang bcas// sprin bzhin myur du gtibs nas kyang*// bdag gi bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang rang gi dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag |chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su 'khyil ba las/ gtso bo dgu la he ru ka re re dang 'khor la rang rang gi gtso bos dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces brjod/ bzhugs su gsol zhing mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ me ri dmar nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su// dur khrod 'bar ba'i gnas mchog nyams nga bar// gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo chen po'i steng*// rang rang rigs mthun dgra bgegs gdan steng du// dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs nas kyang*// bdag la gnag pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// dug khrag sngags kyis btab pa'i mchod yon dang*// bong bu mi'i chu gla rtsi'i dris sbags pa'i// zhabs |gzer nad khrag skyug nyal thag chod// mtho ba rnams ni zhabs skums shig /dma' ba rnams ni dbu mar chum// bar la bzhugs pa sku zur zhig /pho brang rnams kyang sgo chod cig |na bza' lhab lhub mtha' bsdus shig /sku bzur de ni spyan g.yol zhig /zor dang mdos kyi lam phyes shig /sgo ba rnams kyi sgo phyes shig /'phrang ma rnams kyi 'phrang sel zhig |da ni zor 'phen gang du 'phen// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// sdang bar byed pa'i dgra la 'phen// byad ma phur kha mkhan la 'phen// gnod par byed pa'i bgegs la 'phen| |sgo na god kha che la 'phen// phug na khyim chags che la 'phen// nad 'dre chung bdag byed la 'phen// mo ngan chags kha che la 'phen// rmi lam chags kha che la 'phen// dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlogs/ /zhes brjod/ de nas mdos la g.yas skor lan gsum byas nas zhal phyir bsgyur la mdos bskyel ba ni/ hūm̐ */ da ni mdos chen bskyod re ran// da ni dmag dpung bskyod re ran| |nag po chen po sku skyod cig /bka' yi las mkhan sku skyod cig /las kyi pho nya sku skyod cig /lha srin dmag dpung sku skyod cig /dgra bo'i yul du sku skyod cig /chibs kha dgra bo'i yul du sgyur// dgra bo'i yul khams dmag gis khong*// sdang ba'i dgra la sku zur ston// bka' chad sdang ba'i dgra la thong*// thun zor sdang ba'i dgra la phob// dregs byed 'khor bcas dgra la phob// dgra bo mi nor cham la phob// dgra bo'i yul khams brlag par mdzod// oṃ ma hā kā lā ya thun bhyoḥ oṃ ka ru rbad bhyoḥ pra mo ha rbad bhyoḥ ma hā kā lī thun bhyoḥ kaṃ kā la thun bhyoḥ kā la rā tri thun bhyoḥ zhes thun brab/ de nas mdos bteg la sgrub khang gi phyi rol du bzhag la/ sman raka bran la dmag bkye ba ni/ bhyoḥ dbus kyi phyogs nas dmag 'dren no// dmag dpon ye shes mgon pos gyis// dmag sna bya rog gdong gi drongs// dmag rting sha za nag pos skyongs// dmag 'di dgra bo'i yul du drongs// bhyoḥ

/gzhan gyi byad stems phur kha zlog /dri za myos shing rtsub pa zlog /ma mo'i khrag zor dal yams zlog /rgyal po'i smyo 'bog gtong ba zlog /gshin rjes 'khor lo bskor ba zlog /srin pos shwa kha gtong ba zlog /klu yis byad du bcug pa zlog |bdud kyis khram la btab pa zlog /gnod sbyin rtsis la 'debs pa zlog /'byung pos thod zor 'phen pa zlog /'tshe zor yungs zor 'phen pa zlog /mu stegs sngags rgod smod pa zlog |bal mos ngan sngags byed pa zlog /sngags pas phur zor byed pa zlog /the'u rang tshe la rku ba zlog /pha mes chags pa'i rgan sri zlog /glo bur gnod pa'i god 'dre zlog / 'gong po'i god 'dre langs pa zlog /bse rag dri la rku ba zlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /ye 'brog sum brgya nyi shu zlog /bgegs rigs sum brgya drug cu zlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi zlog /rmis ltas mtshan ltas ngan pa zlog /lo skag zla skag mchis pa zlog /gza' skag bdud skag mchis pa zlog /rus kyi gshed bzhi mchis pa zlog /bandes sngags zor 'phen pa zlog /bon pos lha zor 'phen pa zlog /zhang zhung btso dmar 'phen pa zlog /skyes pas mda' zor 'phen pa zlog /bud med dmod zor 'phen pa zlog /mthu grub byad kha thams cad zlog /bdud dang gshin rje srin po dang*// btsan dang ma mo rgyal po dang*// klu dang gnod sbyin 'byung po dang*// gza' dang rgyu skar byad stems dang*| |mi mthun gnod pa'i tshogs rnams zlog /sdang ba'i dgra bgegs thog tu bhyoḥ zhes dang*/ slar khram bzlog ni/ hūm̐ */ ma hā kā lā mthu bo che// khram kha bsgyur ba'i nag po che// pho bdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur// mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur// chung bdud dal kha thad du sgyur// spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la sgyur// sho kha chen po da phyes shig /rtsis kha chen po da phyes shig |do nub lha 'dres dmag sna sgyur// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// gzhan gyi byad stems phur kha zlog
